name: Proofpoint - User Clicked Malicious Link
description: A user clicked a URL that Proofpoint identified as malicious; URL Defense blocked the click.
alert_description:
What fired: a user clicked a known-bad link in an email and Proofpoint URL Defense BLOCKED the request (click-blocked).

Why it matters: the user demonstrated susceptibility and intent to engage. Even though blocked, treat as a phishing-prone / targeted user and a potential compromise attempt.

Investigate:
  - Review the mapped recipient, subject and threat URL.
  - Confirm there was no earlier PERMITTED click to the same/related domain (rule for click-permitted), and check web proxy/EDR for any successful connection.
  - Consider user-awareness follow-up.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1566.002 - Spearphishing Link (TA0001 - Initial Access).
